sample_unit: paired patient education topics (25 per specialty)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid), quality, understandability, actionability of AI vs society patient materials by specialty
links.effect: Surgery: AI lower reading level and higher quality/understandability/actionability (p<0.001). Anesthesiology: AI more readable (p<0.001). Ophthalmology: AI more readable but society higher quality/understandability. Gastroenterology: AI higher reading level (p<0.001).
links.quote: In gastroenterology, AI materials had higher reading levels (p<0.001) with no differences in quality or usability.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of ChatGPT-generated patient education materials against professional society materials on readability and health literacy metrics; does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
